sources.entry: Beekeeper Studio - SQL editor and manager with support for SQLite, MySQL, MariaDB, Postgres, CockroachDB, SQL Server, and Amazon Redshift.

summary.one_liner: Beekeeper Studio is a cross-platform SQL editor and database manager for Linux, Mac, and Windows that connects to many relational and non-relational databases.
summary.what_it_does: Beekeeper Studio is a desktop SQL editor and database manager available for Linux, macOS, and Windows. The README lists full support for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, Amazon Redshift, CockroachDB, MariaDB, TiDB, Google BigQuery, and Redis, with paid-edition support for many more such as Oracle, MongoDB, ClickHouse, DuckDB, Snowflake, and DynamoDB (beta). Features named include an autocomplete SQL editor with syntax highlighting, tabbed interface, table sort and filter, saved queries, query run-history, a dark theme, import/export, backup/restore, and viewing data as JSON. The README describes the Community Edition as GPLv3 open source, with some premium features under a commercial license. The repo is a monorepo built with Electron and Vue.js, with local build steps given for contributors.
use_cases: Run SQL queries against PostgreSQL or MySQL databases
Browse and edit tables in SQLite files
Manage SQL Server or Amazon Redshift databases from one app
Back up and restore a database
Query MongoDB, ClickHouse, or Snowflake from a desktop client (paid editions)
how_to_run: Fork the beekeeper-studio repo and clone your fork
cd beekeeper-studio/ && yarn set version classic
notable: Supports a broad range of databases, including SQLite, Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server, and Redshift, in one app
Built as a fork of sqlectron-core, the core database libraries from the Sqlectron project
Free to download with no sign-up required; some premium features are paid
Monorepo with separate entry points for Electron main process and Vue app
Community Edition under GPLv3; paid Ultimate Edition under a commercial EULA
caveats: Some databases and features require paid editions under a commercial source-available license
Paid features are in the same repository under a commercial license, not GPLv3
Local build requires Node 20/22, Yarn classic, and may need OpenSSL updates for an error on some systems
summary.license: GPLv3 (Community Edition); Ultimate Edition under commercial EULA
